scope: Synthetic Phase B fixtures under the canonical root only; this is not an assertion that SSHFS is local ext4.
phase_c_protocol_requirements: Write only a fresh .partial object in inbox/ and close/fsync it before hashing.
Verify destination size and SHA256 after reopen before admission.
Use renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE) where available; fail closed on EEXIST rather than overwrite.
Create immutable catalog/entries/<RUN_ID>.json records; deterministic catalog snapshots are not concurrent append logs.
Keep source evidence after transfer acknowledgement; copy success is not deletion authority.
decision_basis: All Phase B required write, reopen, hash, rename, collision and cleanup semantics were observed to work.
